analyst.summary: Smartworks operates large managed office campuses and is growing fast (about 45% CAGR over five years), but it only turned profitable in the last year after a loss the year before, and that thin profit sits on top of nearly Rs 4,800 crore of debt used to build out its campuses. The stock trades at roughly 194 times last year's earnings, a very rich price for a profitability record that is barely twelve months old. We rate this a Sell.
